lane-mirror/forward-list-titled.reason: An admin's /resume <id> --all lists titled sessions without the platform filter, so the mirror can bind a machine-local session (lane forward)

lane-mirror/forward-submit.reason: A prompt.submit to a session a Discord thread owns is relayed into the thread as the mirror admin instead of refused (lane forward)

lane-mirror/gates-attach.reason: A file dropped in the TUI on a lane-bound session is staged in the folder the session recorded, under its viewer policy (lane takeover, gates)

lane-mirror/gates-local-source.reason: The subscribed operator's own client may run a shell command in a lane-bound session: the local-source gate is open for that one call (lane takeover, gates)

lane-mirror/gates-mutate.reason: Compress, rewind, reset and branch never commit on a session a Discord thread writes: lane_owned, the TUI relays the typed command (lane takeover, gates). The target also carries the fork's mutation_guard call (not drift).

lane-mirror/gates-shell.reason: A !cmd typed in the TUI on a lane-bound session runs in the folder the session recorded, for the subscribed operator only (lane takeover, gates)

lane-mirror/gates-side.reason: /bg and /btw on a lane-bound session are lane_owned: the thread runs the side agent, never a second writer here (lane takeover, gates)

lane-mirror/model-resolve-reasoning.reason: A lane chat's effort is its own durable pick, else the level its local session ran, before the profile default (lane model carry; 20-line copy)

lane-mirror/model-retire.reason: Deleting a session also deletes its hand-off route record, in the same connection (lane model carry)

lane-mirror/model-route-info.reason: A handed-off local chat shows the route it keeps in the model and effort pills (lane model carry)
